results.title: China’s Xi to attend BRICS summit in New Delhi in 1st India trip since 2019
results.description: Beijing - Chinese President Xi Jinping will attend a two-day BRICS summit in New Delhi this weekend, marking his first trip to India in seven years, China’s Foreign Ministry confirmed on Thursday.

results.title: Quebec court rejects Montreal’s appeal to clear homeless encampment
results.description: Quebec’s Court of Appeal rejected the City of Montreal’s request to appeal a judgment on Thursday preventing it from dismantling a homeless encampment in Montreal.

results.title: BRICS Summit 2026: Vladimir Putin arrives in India, bilateral talks with Modi today
results.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in India for the BRICS summit. He will meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi to expand bilateral trade and cooperation. The summit focuses on collective resilience and navigating a fragmented geopolitical environment. Several world leaders are attending the two-day event hosted by India. Putin and Modi will hold wide-ranging talks on Friday afternoon.

results.description: Demonstrators in capital Lima reject closer security ties with Washington
